Perked_Sensitive_Ears.description: Bristling with a wolf-like elegance, these pointed and swiveling ears are attuned to the subtlest whispers of the wind, catching high-frequency sounds with an uncanny sensitivity that grants a significant boost to auditory senses.

Swivel_Hunter_Ears.description: Triangular and cat-like, these swiveling hunter ears enhance auditory perception, allowing the wearer to track the faintest sounds with sharp precision and a +2 bonus to sense checks.

Elongated_Directional_Ears.description: The elongated, rabbit-like ears are highly sensitive and alert, swiveling with remarkable dexterity to pinpoint the faintest sounds, granting an enhanced sense_bonus of 4, making the wearer acutely aware of their surroundings.

Echolocation_Ears.description: The Echolocation_Ears, with their large, bat-like structure, emit and detect ultrasonic frequencies, granting the creature unparalleled sonar capabilities that enhance its sense bonus by five, allowing it to navigate and hunt in the darkest, most treacherous environments with eerie precision.
